title: ホープフルSの後に・新時代を2人で

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That's right. I'll run at my own pace… and I'll heed the timing Trainer taught me…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …Now! Accelerate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: This! This is it! This is how I run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Briiight! You're almost there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright used to lament that she never brought any glory to the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But today, she leaves a vivid footprint on their legacy with this decisive G1 victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm back! Thank you for waiting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Good job out there, Bright. Aside from your start, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: You're exactly right. Trainer, please forgive me. I did poorly at the gate like always…
choice_data_list: Still, you made up for it.
Still, you made up for it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That I did. Because you taught me when I should start my final spurt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I can always hear your voice, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suppose after all the training we did with me shouting out when to dash, she's come to hear my voice unconsciously at the right time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, we've proved that the style Mejiro Bright and I have developed together can seize victory even at the G1 level.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Thank you for letting me run in the Hopeful Stakes. It's been quite a challenge…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yet the path ahead of me has opened wide. Just as I expected.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? As you expected?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: There is another race with the same conditions, a 2,000-meter G1 at Nakayama, next year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I may not be the most proactive, but since I was able to run in this race, I believe I will have no problems there either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A 2,000-meter race at Nakayama… The Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright, is your main goal what I think it is?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Is this your trainer's plan?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I was very much aware that today would be a good preliminary test. But it didn't occur to me that Mejiro Bright was thinking along those terms.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may be slow in strolling down her path, but her eyes are fixed firmly on the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: All right, Dober, it's time for us to buckle down. What lies ahead for you is the Triple Tiara. For me, the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It'll be for the Mejiro family we both love and adore, so let's do our best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: We'll do it together! It's about time a Mejiro won a Classics crown again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ever since Mejiro McQueen won the Kikuka Sho, no Mejiro has won a G1 in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the promising winds of victory in the air, Mejiro Bright shoulders the hopes of the Mejiro family and sets her eyes on the Satsuki Sho.
